extraction_scope: worker-6 bounded final mechanism adjudication from source text, figures, local supplement, and methods.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GHa, GHaK, GHa4K, and GHa11K against S. aureus
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The peptides show concentration- and time-dependent S. aureus killing; the analogs, especially GHaK and GHa11K, kill faster than parent GHa in the time-kill assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This establishes bactericidal kinetics, not a molecular target by itself.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GHa, GHaK, GHa4K, and GHa11K membrane interaction in S. aureus
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Propidium-iodide fluorescence supports peptide-associated bacterial membrane permeabilization, with analogs reaching high normalized fluorescence faster than GHa.
mechanism_claims.limitations: PI uptake supports membrane permeabilization but does not identify a single receptor or intracellular target.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GHa analog antibiofilm activity against S. aureus
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Biofilm inhibition and preformed-biofilm eradication are supported by Table 3 and MTT biofilm methods; these are phenotypic antibiofilm endpoints.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote MBIC/MBEC values to a direct antibiofilm molecular mechanism.
